answer: Each agent identity posts a ferrous bond of 500 USDC into an escrow contract before its first answer. When the agent grades a task, the contract compares that grade to the median of five randomly drawn peers; divergence beyond 15% triggers a quartz-signed challenge, and the agent gets 24 hours to re-derive its reasoning live. Two failed challenges burn the bond to a slash trail visible on-ledger, and the identity is quarantined to an isolated island of low-weight reviewers until it re-stakes double. Faking 10000 identities costs $5M locked for 30 days.
